content.markdown: The default implementation of `SnlRenderHooks`. It covers all hooks, including `onHover`, `resolveMacroInfo`, and `resolveSource`, and provides normal interaction when the host does not customize them. A host normally performs a partial merge (`{ ...defaultRenderHooks, onHover: mine }`) rather than replacing the object completely.
